data.long_meaning: Ayzal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ayus', which means 'life'. The suffix 'al' denotes 'shining' or 'radiant'. This name is often given to a child who is believed to bring light and positivity into the world. The name Ayzal carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ayzal usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
